defaultBranchWorkflows.triggerBlock:
pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 9 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm_destructive_account_deletion:
        description: Authorize deletion of a disposable staging account after staging-security review
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      ios_build_id:
        description: Optional exact iOS EAS build UUID or build URL tied to this evidence
        required: false
        type: string

refNote: Existing name is a tag only; matching evidence-only branch is authorized by current evidence-branch protocol. Tag and application refs remain unchanged.
safetyMechanism: Evidence tree contains no workflows; default branch has no create/release/repository_dispatch trigger, and push workflows target main only; commit also carries [skip ci]. No workflow dispatch.
